g.title: TF_INTEROP_SCENARIO_STEPS
g.text: Interoperability Scenarios Steps - Interoperability Scenarios Steps
Indicates that this step will be first processed after 'at least' the specified delay in minutes or later.
The execution delay in minutes after the first execution. The skill will be re-processed after 'at least' the specified delay or later.
Max number of executions before the scenario proceeds with the next step.
It's the condition for this step to execute. If the condition is false, the step is skipped.
It is the condition for step to repeat the execution. When the condition returns false, the loop is stopped.
With this flag active, the scenario will continue even if the step execution returned errors.
